Name: Epic Arsenal Tilesheet
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
Someone on Discord asked me if I could turn these into a custom tilesheet. It was pretty easy to do, so I decided, why not? Here it is, my first tilesheet mod. It's the same sprites but with shadows added.

If you are playing:
Download it and put it in your mods folder. This mod does nothing except load the tilesheet so that other mods can use it.

If you are modding:
Add the tilesheet image to your map and use it. Remove the tilesheet from your map folder before release, this mod will load it.

Feel free to edit it to fit your needs! You just have to set this mod as a dependency in your mod manifest.
